title: Mis amigos
blurbEn: Descriptions of two friends and their pets. Watch how every adjective changes its ending to match what it describes.
body:
Tengo dos amigos muy buenos. Pablo es alto y Sofía es baja.

Los dos son estudiantes. Ellos estudian español en la universidad.

Pablo tiene un perro grande. Sofía tiene dos gatos pequeños. Los gatos son blancos.

Mis amigos son muy divertidos.
translationEn:
I have two very good friends. Pablo is tall and Sofía is short.

The two of them are students. They study Spanish at the university.

Pablo has a big dog. Sofía has two small cats. The cats are white.

My friends are very funny.

buenos.note: Plural -s, because it describes two friends.

pequeños.note: You have seen 'pequeña' for a house. Here it is masculine and plural, for two cats.
